items.title: Chuck Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 7, 2023
items.q: And Iola was an angel. ... My God. What a powerful, quiet powerful woman. You know? That was a killer couple, man.

ctx.x: Yeah, right, I was going to say man. Oh God, man, yeah that was a thrill when you asked if I was apprehensive about joining the quartet, but you know I was really excited about it but within the first minute I’m going, “When can I meet your dad?” You know I was like that’s going to happen now, I’m going to get to meet him. So that was really exciting.
My God. What a powerful, quiet powerful woman. You know? That was a killer couple, man.
